title: 10 AI Tools Every Kenyan Small Business Should Try
excerpt: Practical, affordable AI tools that save time and generate results — from content creation to customer support.

content.text: AI isn't just for tech companies anymore. Small businesses in Kenya are using AI tools to save time, cut costs, and compete with bigger players.
Here are 10 practical AI tools every Kenyan small business should try.
Use for: Blog posts, email drafts, social media captions, product descriptions. The free tier is surprisingly capable for basic content needs.
Use for: Social media graphics, presentations, product mockups. The AI features help you create professional designs without a designer.
Use for: Video editing, Reels, TikTok content. AI-powered editing features save hours of manual work.
Use for: Website chatbots, automated customer support. Handle common questions 24/7 without hiring support staff.
Use for: Automated replies, quick responses, business profile. The most-used messaging platform in Kenya — and it's free.
Use for: Email marketing automation, newsletters, customer segmentation. Free tier handles up to 500 contacts.
Use for: Social media scheduling, analytics, ad management. AI-powered insights help you post at optimal times.
Use for: Document creation, meeting notes, project management. AI assists with writing, summarizing, and organizing.
Use for: Data analysis, reporting, automation. AI add-ons can analyze trends and generate insights from your data.
Use for: Connecting apps and automating workflows. Automate repetitive tasks like data entry, email routing, and form processing.
Start with 2-3 tools that solve your biggest pain points. Don't try to adopt everything at once — master one tool before adding another.

items: Choose one tool for each problem
Spend a week learning it properly
Measure the time or money saved
Scale what works, drop what doesn't

content.text: "We started with ChatGPT for content and Tidio for support. The time savings alone paid for both tools in the first month." — Owner, Nairobi boutique
